When you tap a github.com link somewhere else, you can open it right here instead of a browser.\n\ngithub.com is GitHub\'s own domain, and the system will not hand that permission to a third-party app automatically (only the official client gets it). You need to turn on \"Open supported links\" once, in system settings.

When you tap a github.com link somewhere else, open it right here instead of a browser. github.com is someone else\'s domain and we cannot \"prove\" to the system that it belongs to this app (that would need GitHub to host a declaration file), so you need to turn on \"Open supported links\" once, in system settings.

Checks your unread notifications in the background and shows a system notification when something new arrives (tap it to open the app).
GitHub has no push channel for third-party clients, so this is real polling: the shortest interval is 1 minute, but the system will delay it in deep sleep to save battery.
Short intervals cost battery; Android will still delay checks when the phone is in deep sleep.
